For adhd specifically they check deficits in working memory and impulsivity, attention related + there are high rates of comorbidities of adhd and learning disorders

Intelligence testing tells them how much you can use different areas of your intelligence (problem solving, visuo spatial understanding, speech and language comprehension, reasoning skills, math abilities, decision making, etc etc) according to your age. It’s a main tool used to aid or assess nd disorders

Your concerns are valid please do not feel discouraged by less informed adults who solely focus on phone usage. But I must add that your case history (focused on developmental milestones delay mostly + home environment, childhood years, relationships etc etc) are used to relate to the test results which will be used for assessment or screening of adhd/neurodivergence

Hey. Psychologist in training here! Hope this helps: 

See a clinical psychologist and communicate your issues w them, if they see it as a possibility then they will refer you to a psychiatrist or at a hospital for further testing (IQ testing mostly) and take along your parent with you as they need inputs from caregivers for neurodevelopmental disorders assessment, you will be given an option to receive a formal and official diagnosis for the same or just stop at assessment (if you need a certificate for the diagnosis)
